verdict.rationale: Missive documents a public REST API at /v1 covering conversations, drafts, posts, contacts and labels, plus an MCP server, so it can be driven programmatically without the UI. Drafts created through the API are explicitly supported, and rate limits are documented for scripted use. However, nothing documents a CLI, a headless runner, or CI integration. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless mode, CI/pipeline usage docs or examples, OpenAPI spec (probes 404), independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
